rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a person who steals.

example.english: The thief was caught by the police.
example.jyutping: go2 go3 caak6 bei2 ging2 caat3 zuk1 zo2

rows.note: Use this especially for a petty thief or someone who steals secretly rather than by force.

example.english: A thief secretly stole my phone.
example.traditional: 我部電話俾小偷偷走咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 bei2 siu2 tau1 tau1 zau2 zo2
